charting.title: Association between resting-state functional brain connectivity and gene expression is altered in autism spectrum disorder
charting.primary_goal: Identify genes whose cortical expression is differentially correlated with resting-state brain activity (fALFF, ReHo) between ASD and control individuals.
charting.study_setting: Multi-site (37 sites overall; 30 sites in the site-correction step)
charting.comorbidities_included_excluded: Individuals with Chromosome 15q Duplication were excluded from downstream gene-expression analysis
charting.data_types: resting-state fMRI, post-mortem cortical RNA-seq gene expression
charting.dataset_openly_available: Yes - code on GitHub; ABIDE imaging data available to approved investigators via NITRC/1000 Functional Connectomes registration
charting.specific_features: fALFF and ReHo averaged over an 11-region Brodmann-area atlas matched to RNA-seq regions
charting.importance_method: Fisher r-to-z transformation of ASD vs CTL gene-fMRI correlations, combined via Fisher's method, FDR-corrected
charting.top_features_identified: FILIP1 and GABRQ among genes with highest effect size
charting.feature_change_direction: 415 differentially correlated (DC) genes identified; 59.8% showed similarly-signed positive correlation with fALFF/ReHo in both groups
charting.summary_key_findings: 415 genes were differentially correlated between ASD and controls with rs-fMRI activity (fALFF/ReHo) at Diff Cor P<0.01, CTL FDR<0.05, with effect sizes >1.8 for ~3% of expressed genes; these DC genes show altered postnatal developmental expression trajectories relevant to ASD.
charting.features_associated_disorder: Cortical regional fALFF/ReHo correlated with expression of 415 genes (including FILIP1, GABRQ) differently in ASD vs controls, especially in primary visual and inferior temporal cortex.

narrative_row.study_design_sample_dataset: Associational; ABIDE I+II, 37 sites, 710 ASD (79% male) / 606 CTL (87% male) after QC, ages 5-64
narrative_row.methods: C-PAC v1.8.0 preprocessing, fALFF and ReHo computed per voxel then parcellated into 11 Brodmann-area ROIs matched to post-mortem RNA-seq regions; site-mean correction; age/site/sex regressed out; Fisher r-to-z difference testing between ASD and CTL correlations, combined via Fisher's method, FDR-corrected.
narrative_row.outcomes: 415 genes differentially correlated with fALFF/ReHo between ASD and controls (Diff Cor P<0.01, CTL FDR<0.05); effect size >1.8 for ~3% of expressed genes; developmental expression trajectories of these genes altered into adulthood.
narrative_row.key_limitations: Restricted to 11 cortical regions available from rare post-mortem ASD tissue; gene-expression comparison used a further random-subsampling procedure (e.g., ASD N=360 / Healthy N=302 in the depicted analysis) distinct from the full imaging QC sample.
narrative_row.relevance_notes: Large, multi-site, well-documented ABIDE I+II QC and site-correction pipeline (CPAC, Brodmann atlas) linking imaging phenotypes to transcriptomic data; code publicly released.
